The `unquote` function has an off-by-one bug: `_ASCII_RE.split(string)` puts the ASCII run (which contains the `%`-escapes) at odd indices (bits[1], bits[3], ...), but the loop does `range(2, len(bits), 2)` instead of `range(1, len(bits), 2)`. I'll fix this off-by-one and verify with a few quick tests.
